full_judgment: 2. The trial Court dismissed the suit at the first instance. On appeal the decision was set aside and the case sent back on remand for fresh trial. After the arrival of the records while the suit was lying pending for disposal in the First Court of Assistant Judge, Barisal the learned District Judge, by an order dated 15 July 1992 transferred the suit from the said court to the Second Additional Court of Assistant Judge, Barisal for disposal. There was no appearance of the contesting defendant before the transferees court. As a result the learned Assistant Judge, Second Additional Court heard the matter ex parte but dismissed the suit on 30 August 1992. The plaintiff took an appeal; Title Appeal No. 195 of 1992 therefrom. The appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat who reversed the decision of the trial Court and decreed the suit on 8 November 1993. Being aggrieved defendant No. 1 preferred Civil Revision No. 221 of 1994. A Single Bench of the High Court Division set aside the decree of the appellate Court on the view that the defendant was not informed of the transfer of the suit from the First Court of Assistant Judge, Barisal to the Second Additional Court, Barisal as required under section 24A(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure for which he could not defend his cause in the case. Accordingly the learned Judge sent back the case on remand to the trial Court for disposal by his judgment and order dated 24 February 1997.
